description: Empty Accounts. Calls only GET /v4/wallets/{ownerAddress}/empty-accounts and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching empty Token-2022 and SPL token accounts for a wallet. Returns results to identify accounts eligible for rent cleanup.

limit.description: Maximum number of empty accounts to return. Defaults to 1000.

ownerAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields. Path parameter for /v4/wallets/{ownerAddress}/empty-accounts.

page.description: Page number to return (zero-indexed). Defaults to 0.

sortByAsc.description: Sort ascending by 'tokenAccountAddress', 'mintAddress', 'name', 'symbol', 'decimals', or 'rentUsd'. If omitted, no sorting is applied. Only one of `sortByAsc` or `sortByDesc` can be used.

sortByDesc.description: Sort descending by 'tokenAccountAddress', 'mintAddress', 'name', 'symbol', 'decimals', or 'rentUsd'. If omitted, no sorting is applied. Only one of `sortByAsc` or `sortByDesc` can be used.

name: get-wallet-empty-accounts
title: Empty Accounts
